aboutGame.title: What is Survive The Swarm?
paragraphs: Survive The Swarm is an intense roguelike survival action game on Roblox developed by GeekOut Studio. Trapped in hostile arenas, players must fight off escalating hordes of relentless alien creatures, collect experience crystals, and unlock powerful weapon evolutions.

Featuring multiple hero classes, rich weapon upgrade paths, and deep elemental synergies, every run tests your positioning, decision-making, and build strategy as you fight to become the ultimate survivor.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Survive The Swarm on Roblox.

items.question: What is Survive The Swarm?
items.answer: Survive The Swarm is an action-packed survival roguelike game on Roblox where players battle endless hordes of insectoid and alien enemies, upgrade their weapons, level up unique heroes, and survive as long as possible.

items.question: How do I redeem Survive The Swarm codes?
items.answer: Open the game on Roblox, locate the Twitter/Code icon on the screen, paste your active code from our Codes page, and click Redeem to claim your free in-game rewards.

items.question: What are the best weapons and builds in Survive The Swarm?
items.answer: High area-of-effect (AoE) weapons combined with cooldown reduction and movement speed passives are generally considered the strongest builds for clearing dense swarms and surviving late-game waves.

items.question: How do weapon evolutions work?
items.answer: When you upgrade a base weapon to its maximum level while holding its corresponding passive item, your weapon evolves into an ultra-powerful variant with enhanced damage and unique visual effects.

items.question: Is Survive The Swarm free to play?
items.answer: Yes, Survive The Swarm is completely free to play on Roblox across PC, mobile devices, and consoles.
